728-3249-4289-5004.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

5662-8095--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5662-8095--5--195.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1870-2416-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-2416-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-2416-4873-5087.description:
Use Rise and Shine to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

654-4365-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares
Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-4113-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
1170-4113-7577.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares using the convoke ability from Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Emeritus of Truce.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Truce, which enters prepared.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6965-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4893-7426-7628-7811.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4893-7426-7628-7811.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1563-1849-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-1849-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-1849-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

391-757-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

757-3094-3181.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

206-1402-2218-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1661-3459-5078-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2730-4050-5181.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Findbroker, adding {B}.
When Golgari Findbroker dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Golgari Findbroker.
Repeat.

821-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

116-515-1636.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

270-1247-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Hedron Archive's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

500-1181-4863.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Revolutionist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Revolutionist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Revolutionist token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

3705-5231-5997-6705.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing Squee, the Frog and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

5938-6790.easyPrerequisites:
You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You control a nontoken red creature or have an additional {1}{R} available.
5938-6790.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pyromancer's Goggles by tapping it, adding {R}.
Cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost or by sacrificing a nontoken red creature, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Pyromancer's Goggles triggers, copying Flare of Duplication, with the copy targeting the original Flare of Duplication.
Resolve the copy of Flare of Duplication, creating a copy of Flare of Duplication targeting the original Flare of Duplication.
Repeat step 5.

199-3946-6701.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

224-1772-3861-6664.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

567-1274-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-1274-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2452-3967-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2452-3967-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ebondeath, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

252-1270-1527-4911.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to that creature equal to its toughness or greater.
You control at least two untapped artifacts.
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
252-1270-1527-4911.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible by any method, if needed.
Deal damage to that creature at least equal to its toughness, using Ghirapur Aether Grid or any other method.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two untapped artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to the indestructible creature with lethal damage already marked on it.
Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating three 7/7 Treasure Dinosaur artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Once you have infinite untapped artifact creature tokens, you may activate Ghirapur's Aether Grid any number of times, choosing any targets.
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating three Treasure artifact tokens that become 7/7 Dinosaur creatures in addition to their other types as they enter.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite tokens, you may tap them using Ghirapur's Aether Grid to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

213-2232-4940.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
213-2232-4940.description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Adaptive Sporesinger and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Adaptive Sporesinger and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Bloom Hulk triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Adaptive Sporesinger trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Adaptive Sporesinger and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

513-2792-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
513-2792-3821.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Great Whale to your hand from the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.

871-3006-4050-4399-5105.description:
Cast Hada Freeblade by paying {W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Whenever Hada Freeblade enters the battlefield, it and Ondu Cleric trigger.
Resolve the Hada Freeblade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ondu Cleric trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Hada Freeblade and the Soldier token, adding {1}{W}.
Whenever Hada Freeblade dies, Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Hada Freeblade from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1624-1859-3646-4827.manaNeeded: {8}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-1859-3646-4827.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Strovald by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving Evra base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2438-3451-3689-4766.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard with mana value four or greater.
2438-3451-3689-4766.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Workshop Assistant.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning an artifact creature card with mana value four or greater from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the artifact creature with mana value four or greater from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return a creature card with mana value two or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Workshop Assistant from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 6, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1365-2829-4853-4907.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Tatterkite persist until end of turn.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Tatterkite dies, triggering its persist ability and Dross Scorpion.
Resolve the Tatterkite trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1409-1530-3544.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Auramancer.
1409-1530-3544.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
Activate Auramancer by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Auramancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Auramancer.
Resolve the Auramancer trigger, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2776-4222-4241.description:
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling your unspent mana.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Doubling Cube to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Doubling Cube.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Doubling Cube.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling your unspent mana.
Repeat from step 4.
